topic: Modern trade share of food retail
claim_a: USDA GAIN 2024 (CHN-02): modern trade 15% of retail value in 2023 (bar chart, Euromonitor)
claim_b: USDA GAIN 2025 (CHN-01): modern retail 13% in 2024 (pie excludes food and drink specialists)
position_taken: Use 13% (2024) for supermarkets, hypermarkets and convenience; the 15% includes specialists. Like-for-like the share rose from 12% (2023) to 13% (2024)

claim_a: WinCommerce CEO (CHN-15): 12% to 14% of grocery, 2024 to 2025
position_taken: Report both; treat 14% for 2025 as a company claim (Low)
notes: No method disclosed by the company

claim_b: USDA Retail 2025 (CHN-01): Food Service-HRI USD 27.3 billion
position_taken: Prefer USD 26.6 billion from the dedicated HRI report
notes: GSO accommodation and catering revenue (VND 733,920 bn, 2024) includes accommodation and is not comparable

position_taken: Report both; different definitions (outlets vs operators) and dates
notes: High churn means any count is a snapshot

topic: Share of fresh meat through traditional channels
claim_a: Euromonitor via B&Company (CHN-18): around 80% of fresh meat market
claim_b: Systematic review (CHN-19): over 95% of pork retailers sell at wet markets
position_taken: Both hold: one is value share, the other a share of retailers. Use about 80% of value as the working figure (Low)
notes: Rural Dien Bien respondents: almost 90% prefer wet markets (CHN-20)

claim_a: Saigon Times 2024 (CHN-41) and B&Company via CafeF 2026 (CHN-35): about USD 2 billion a year
claim_b: Cong Thuong 2019 (CHN-42): about VND 1,000 billion a day (about USD 14 billion a year)
position_taken: Use USD 2 billion; reject the 2019 figure
notes: The 2019 claim has no method and is seven times larger

notes: Food plus labour plus commissions leaves little room for 20% to 35%
